About

Adlan is a digital craftsman and independent web developer based in Reims (Grand Est, France), specializing in eco-designed websites and web performance.

Philosophy & Craft

I approach web development as a craft: every line of code is written with care, simplicity, and sustainability. I prioritize lightweight, long-lasting static architectures over bloated software stacks.

Based in Reims, France, I partner with regional and international organizations to deliver eco-designed, accessible digital tools.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Where are you based and what areas do you cover?+

I am based in Reims, in the Grand Est region of France. I work locally in Reims, Châlons-en-Champagne, Troyes, Épernay, Charleville-Mézières, and Soissons, as well as remotely for international projects.

What is an eco-designed website?+

An eco-designed website is optimized to use minimal computational power and energy. This translates to lean code, fast page loads, no heavy trackers, and a significantly reduced carbon footprint.

What technologies do you build with?+

I primarily use Astro, TypeScript, semantic HTML5, and Vanilla CSS. This stack guarantees top-tier performance, security, and low maintenance overhead.

Are your websites accessible to users with disabilities?+

Yes, all my web builds comply with WCAG 2.2 AA standards, ensuring full keyboard navigation, verified color contrast, and proper semantic markup.
